correctness.rationale: Exact biological equilibrium and Jacobian matrices were independently reconstructed by rational differentiation and reproduced by `check.py`. The characteristic equation is \(P(\lambda)+Q(\lambda)e^{-\lambda\tau}=0\), with \(F(X)=(X-27/20)(X-8/5)\), which has exactly two positive squared frequencies. Exact phases give every possible imaginary crossing, and \(\operatorname{Re}\!\left((d\lambda/d\tau)^{-1}\right)=F^{\prime}(\omega^2)/|P(i\omega)|^2\) gives strictly opposite crossing directions. The zero-delay polynomial is Hurwitz, \(\Delta(0,\tau)=18/5>0\), and a uniform root modulus bound excludes entry from infinity. Retarded-equation linearization gives local nonlinear stability away from thresholds, while regularity and strict inequalities give open-set parameter robustness. No nonlinear assertion is made at the crossing delays.

originality.rationale: Motivating full-text Section 3 treats a first Hopf switch subject to a sign condition (A2), whereas the witness frequency polynomial has two positive simple roots and strictly positive constant term. Prior full-text Sui–Du establishes the same qualitative delay switch for a spatially diffusive model with delayed fear response, not this unmodified two-species predator self-limitation model. Prior exact same-source controlled example addresses a different altered system and parameter vector; it cannot imply the present unmodified delayed-system witness. Broad reentrant-delay behavior is expressly not claimed as first known. No checked published claim covers the specific vector, phases, local root counts and open-neighborhood stability return.
residual_risks: Older broad stability-switch frameworks might imply aspects of the delay-crossing method, which is not claimed new; only the explicit feasible model-specific witness and its robustness are claimed.

A stage-structured related paper and two other qualitative switching papers were accessible in indexed excerpts/abstracts, not full text; that limits certainty about any broad transferable theorem, though their described models differ structurally.
Published database search does not expose private unpublished results or prove uniqueness.

value.rationale: A parameter-explicit, robust restoration of local coexistence stability in the same two-population predator-self-limitation delay model that previously had a one-frequency first-Hopf analysis addresses a specific mathematical gap. The exact rational coefficients and closed-form phase thresholds distinguish an actual open stability window, not simply a numerical or formal Hopf condition. The fact identifies that predator self-competition alone, without fear response, diffusion, controller or stage structure, suffices for biologically feasible restabilization. It makes no paper-sized contribution or broad first-discovery assertion and states limitations.
